tools.name: propose_roof_update
tools.title: Propose roof or segment update
tools.description: Update, add, or atomically split semantic roof segments while preserving explicit support links, perpendicular ridge directions, finishes, and typed valley/intersection junctions.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Update, add, or atomically split semantic roof segments while preserving explicit support links, perpendicular ridge directions, finishes, and typed valley/intersection junctions.
prompt.input: Input is a JSON object with required `buildingRef` and `action` (`update`, `add-segment`, or `split-segment`; default `update`). For `update`, optional `roofRef` or `segmentRef` selects the complete roof or one segment; segment updates may set `footprint`, `ridgeDirection` (`x` or `z`), `storeyRef`, and `spaceRef`. For `add-segment`, require new `segmentRef`, polygon `footprint`, and `ridgeDirection`; optional support, geometry, elevation, and finish fields initialize it. For `split-segment`, require the malformed source `segmentRef`, `segments` with at least two complete replacement definitions (`segmentRef`, `footprint`, `ridgeDirection`, optional `storeyRef`, `spaceRef`, geometry, elevation, and finish), and `junctions` with stable `ref`, `type` (`valley` or `intersection`), and exactly two `segmentRefs`. Replacement fields omitted during a split inherit from the source segment. Common geometry fields are `roofType`, `pitchDegrees` (0–70), and `overhangM` (0–3). Use at most one vertical instruction: `baseElevationM`, `targetEavesElevationM`, `verticalDeltaM`, or `alignToSegmentRef` with optional `alignEdge` (`eaves` or `ridge`). Finish fields are `material` and six-digit `colorHex`; `synchronization` is `roof-only`, `roof-and-supporting-walls`, or `storey-height`.
prompt.tools: Call get_project_state first. Create a ghost variant, compare it if useful, and call manage_variant with action `request-apply` only when the person should review it. Never claim the variant is committed before approval.
prompt.output: Call this WebMCP tool with a JSON object. Read content[0].text as JSON containing status, projectRevision and summary plus tool-specific fields. Never treat visible report image object URLs as tool output. A valid change returns status "variant_created" and variantRef; it does not modify the committed project.

action.description: Operation to perform; one of the listed values for this tool.

roofRef.description: Roof ref when the update targets the complete roof, e.g. roof/main.

footprint.description: Straight-edged polygon of {x,z} building-local metres, 3 to 64 points.

ridgeDirection.description: Axis the ridge runs along: x or z.

storeyRef.description: Stable storey ref, e.g. storey/ground or house/main/storey-upper.

segments.description: Replacement segment definitions for split-segment: segmentRef, footprint, ridgeDirection and optional geometry or finish.

junctions.description: Roof junctions {ref, type valley|intersection, segmentRefs [a, b]} between touching segments.

roofType.description: Roof form: flat, gable or hip.

overhangM.description: Roof overhang beyond the walls in metres, 0 to 3.

baseElevationM.description: Base or eaves elevation in building-local metres.

targetEavesElevationM.description: Absolute eaves elevation to move the segment to, in building-local metres.

verticalDeltaM.description: Relative vertical move of the segment eaves in metres.

material.description: Wall material: charred-timber, natural-timber, light-render, brick or metal-panel.

synchronization.description: roof-only moves the roof; roof-and-supporting-walls also resizes walls; storey-height changes the storey.

alignToSegmentRef.description: Segment whose eaves or ridge this segment should align to.

alignEdge.description: Which edge to align: eaves or ridge; requires alignToSegmentRef.

tools.name: propose_planting_area

tools.description: Create one deterministic, atomic planting scheme along a site/parcel boundary, a custom polyline, or inside a polygon. The tool applies offsets, spacing, rows and corner treatment; skips modeled buildings, access routes, entrances and drainage zones; and reports unmapped utility risk before approval.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Create one deterministic, atomic planting scheme along a site/parcel boundary, a custom polyline, or inside a polygon.
